rules.reason: No evaluator receipt: missing evidence, stage dependency, request cap, provider unavailable or unassessed scope. This is not a pass.
VPAA must identify the approved export template/version, layout acceptance criteria and the exported artifact to inspect. PDF layout regression tests do not verify an individual checking run.
VPAA/Registrar must supply an approved, versioned grading policy with applicable program/course scope and permitted component/formula constraints. GRADE-100 alone does not establish that policy.

Registrar must supply approved curriculum/reference versions, effective cohorts, provenance and supersession rules. CUR-REF validates selection/availability; a content fingerprint is not institutional version approval.

VPAA must supply the authoritative definition, scope, evidence requirements and decision rubric for reserved CLO-05. No scoped implementation or approved definition was located; no meaning is inferred from this identifier.

VPAA must supply the authoritative definition, scope, evidence requirements and decision rubric for reserved PLAN-06. No scoped implementation or approved definition was located; no meaning is inferred from this identifier.

VPAA must supply the authoritative definition, scope, evidence requirements and decision rubric for reserved ALN-03. No scoped implementation or approved definition was located; no meaning is inferred from this identifier.
